meanings.en: not including; other than
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone came to the meeting except Tom.
meanings.exampleTr: Tom hariç herkes toplantıya geldi.

meanings.en: used before stating the only thing that is different
meanings.exampleEn: I would go, except that it's too far.
meanings.exampleTr: Giderdim, ancak çok uzak.

meanings.en: apart from; not including
meanings.exampleEn: The room was empty except for a single chair.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda tek bir sandalye dışında boştu.

meanings.en: free from an obligation or requirement
meanings.exampleEn: Children under five are exempt from the fee.
meanings.exampleTr: Beş yaşından küçük çocuklar ücretten muaftır.

meanings.en: to free someone from a duty or payment
meanings.exampleEn: The new law exempts small businesses from the tax.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa küçük işletmeleri vergiden muaf tutuyor.

meanings.en: a piece of paper with practice tasks or questions on it
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher handed out an exercise sheet on irregular verbs.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen düzensiz fiillerle ilgili bir alıştırma kağıdı dağıttı.

meanings.en: making you feel very happy and excited
meanings.exampleEn: Skiing down the mountain was an exhilarating experience.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağdan kayak yapmak coşku veren bir deneyimdi.

meanings.en: to dig up a dead body from the ground, especially for examination
meanings.exampleEn: The court ordered the body to be exhumed for further tests.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, daha fazla test için cesedin mezardan çıkarılmasını emretti.

meanings.en: a person who lives in a country that is not their own
meanings.exampleEn: Many expatriates gathered at the embassy for the celebration.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok gurbetçi kutlama için elçilikte toplandı.

meanings.en: to make a process happen more quickly
meanings.exampleEn: We paid extra to expedite the delivery of the order.
meanings.exampleTr: Siparişin teslimatını hızlandırmak için ekstra ödeme yaptık.

meanings.en: to officially force someone to leave a school or organization
meanings.exampleEn: He was expelled from school for cheating.
meanings.exampleTr: Kopya çektiği için okuldan atıldı.

meanings.en: to force something out, especially air or gas
meanings.exampleEn: The engine expels hot gases through the exhaust.
meanings.exampleTr: Motor sıcak gazları egzozdan dışarı atar.

meanings.en: to come to the end of a period of validity
meanings.exampleEn: My passport expires next month.
meanings.exampleTr: Pasaportumun süresi gelecek ay doluyor.

meanings.en: a report that reveals shocking or dishonest facts
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper published an exposé on corruption in the city council.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete, belediye meclisindeki yolsuzlukla ilgili bir ifşa haberi yayınladı.

meanings.en: able to be shown or described in words
meanings.exampleEn: Some emotions are hardly expressible in language.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı duygular dille zor ifade edilebilir.

meanings.en: the quality of showing feelings or thoughts clearly and effectively
meanings.exampleEn: The pianist played with great expressiveness.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyanist büyük bir anlatım gücüyle çaldı.

meanings.en: to speak or perform without preparation
meanings.exampleEn: When he lost his notes, he had to extemporize the whole speech.
meanings.exampleTr: Notlarını kaybedince tüm konuşmayı doğaçlama yapmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: able to be made longer or larger
meanings.exampleEn: The contract is extendable for another two years.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme iki yıl daha uzatılabilir.

meanings.en: to kill all the members of a group of animals or people
meanings.exampleEn: They hired a company to exterminate the rats in the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Binadaki fareleri yok etmek için bir şirket tuttular.

meanings.en: the act of killing all the members of a group
meanings.exampleEn: The pesticide led to the extermination of the entire insect colony.
meanings.exampleTr: Böcek ilacı, tüm böcek kolonisinin yok edilmesine yol açtı.

meanings.en: no longer burning or alight
meanings.exampleEn: The firefighters made sure every flame was extinguished.
meanings.exampleTr: İtfaiyeciler her alevin söndürüldüğünden emin oldular.

meanings.en: the process of removing or taking something out
meanings.exampleEn: The dentist recommended the extraction of the damaged tooth.
meanings.exampleTr: Diş hekimi hasarlı dişin çekilmesini önerdi.

meanings.en: the country or origin of a person's family
meanings.exampleEn: She is of Italian extraction.
meanings.exampleTr: O, İtalyan kökenlidir.

meanings.en: coming from or existing outside the Earth
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists are searching for signs of extraterrestrial life.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları dünya dışı yaşamın izlerini arıyor.

meanings.en: outgoing and enjoying being with other people
meanings.exampleEn: Her extroverted personality makes her great at networking.
meanings.exampleTr: Dışa dönük kişiliği onu ilişki kurmada çok başarılı yapıyor.

meanings.en: to feel or show great happiness, especially at a success
meanings.exampleEn: The fans exulted when their team won the championship.
meanings.exampleTr: Taraftarlar takımları şampiyonluğu kazanınca sevinçten coştu.

meanings.en: excellent; wonderful (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: We had a fab time at the party last night.
meanings.exampleTr: Dün gece partide harika vakit geçirdik.

meanings.en: to invent false information in order to deceive
meanings.exampleEn: He fabricated an excuse to avoid the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan kaçmak için bir bahane uydurdu.

meanings.en: to make or manufacture something
meanings.exampleEn: The parts are fabricated in a local factory.
meanings.exampleTr: Parçalar yerel bir fabrikada imal ediliyor.

meanings.en: a person who helps a group discuss or work together effectively
meanings.exampleEn: The workshop facilitator kept the discussion on track.
meanings.exampleTr: Atölye moderatörü tartışmanın yolundan çıkmamasını sağladı.

meanings.tr: gerçeklere dayalı yazı, kurgu dışı yazım
meanings.en: writing based on real facts rather than imagination
meanings.exampleEn: News reports are a common form of factual writing.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber raporları, gerçeklere dayalı yazının yaygın bir biçimidir.

meanings.en: a temperature scale on which water freezes at 32° and boils at 212°
meanings.exampleEn: The temperature reached 90 degrees Fahrenheit today.
meanings.exampleTr: Bugün sıcaklık 90 derece Fahrenhayt'a ulaştı.

meanings.en: a lack of courage or confidence
meanings.exampleEn: His faint-heartedness kept him from taking the risk.
meanings.exampleTr: Cesaretsizliği, o riski almasına engel oldu.

meanings.en: the quality of being loyal and true to someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She was rewarded for her faithfulness to the company.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirkete olan sadakati nedeniyle ödüllendirildi.

meanings.en: disloyal; not able to be trusted
meanings.exampleEn: She felt betrayed by her faithless partner.
meanings.exampleTr: Vefasız partneri tarafından ihanete uğramış hissetti.

meanings.en: the act of making something false in order to deceive
meanings.exampleEn: Critics accused the artist of fakery.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler sanatçıyı sahtekârlıkla suçladı.

meanings.en: a statement that is not true
meanings.exampleEn: The article was full of falsehoods about the candidate.
meanings.exampleTr: Makale, aday hakkında yalanlarla doluydu.

meanings.en: the quality of being untrue or insincere
meanings.exampleEn: There was a falseness in his smile that made her uneasy.
meanings.exampleTr: Gülüşündeki sahtelik onu tedirgin etti.

meanings.en: the act of changing information so that it is no longer true
meanings.exampleEn: He was charged with the falsification of financial records.
meanings.exampleTr: Mali kayıtların tahrif edilmesiyle suçlandı.

meanings.en: to change information so that it is no longer true
meanings.exampleEn: The manager falsified the accounts to hide the losses.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür, zararları gizlemek için hesapları tahrif etti.

meanings.en: to make yourself or someone else know something well
meanings.exampleEn: Please familiarise yourself with the safety rules before starting.
meanings.exampleTr: Başlamadan önce lütfen güvenlik kurallarına aşinalık kazanın.

meanings.en: a person who is extremely enthusiastic about something
meanings.exampleEn: He is a football fanatic who never misses a match.
meanings.exampleTr: O, hiçbir maçı kaçırmayan bir futbol fanatiğidir.

meanings.en: extreme and often unreasonable enthusiasm or belief
meanings.exampleEn: Religious fanaticism has fueled many conflicts in history.
meanings.exampleTr: Dini fanatiklik, tarihte birçok çatışmayı körüklemiştir.

meanings.en: able to plan wisely for the future
meanings.exampleEn: Her far-sighted investments paid off years later.
meanings.exampleTr: İleri görüşlü yatırımları yıllar sonra karşılığını verdi.

meanings.en: able to see distant objects more clearly than near ones
meanings.exampleEn: He is far-sighted and needs glasses for reading.
meanings.exampleTr: Hipermetroptur ve okumak için gözlüğe ihtiyacı vardır.

meanings.tr: şık bir şekilde, modaya uygun olarak
meanings.en: in a way that follows the current style or fashion
meanings.exampleEn: She was fashionably dressed for the gala.
meanings.exampleTr: Galaya modaya uygun bir şekilde giyinmişti.

meanings.en: a death caused by an accident, disaster, or disease
meanings.exampleEn: The crash resulted in three fatalities.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaza üç ölümle sonuçlandı.

meanings.en: the state of being fat or having too much body weight
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor warned him about the health risks of fatness.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor onu şişmanlığın sağlık riskleri konusunda uyardı.

meanings.en: the act of constantly criticizing and looking for mistakes
meanings.exampleEn: Her constant faultfinding made the team feel demoralized.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli kusur bulması ekibin moralini bozdu.

meanings.en: in a way that contains faults or mistakes
meanings.exampleEn: The machine was faultily assembled and soon broke down.
meanings.exampleTr: Makine kusurlu bir şekilde monte edilmişti ve kısa sürede bozuldu.
